post_selection_descriptive: post-selection descriptive: computed on 2024 after the pre-registered platoon gate ran and failed (docs/research-manifest.md, 2026-08-20). Not a test of a hypothesis.

route_rule.rationale: Route A's fragility is structural — a near-total cancellation where a 3% noise-model error swings tau2 by ~100% — and that was known before any number was read.

b_to_b_prime_diagnostic.reading: a large drop toward A means selection into the 2024 eval population explains the gap; no material drop means the remaining A/B' gap is window or estimator
b_to_b_prime_diagnostic.verdict: selection explains part of the gap; the remainder is window or estimator
b_to_b_prime_diagnostic.conditioning_label: Route B' restricts PAST seasons to hitters who reached the 2024 eval population, which conditions on survival to 2024. That is the correct population for a claim about 2024 eval hitters, and it is not a general-population tau2.

route_c.reading: Route C's LHB value sits inside BOTH simulated nulls, so it discriminates nothing: the split-half estimator at these half-length exposures has too much sampling variance to separate tau2=0 from tau2=B'. The alarming -0.366 in E.15 is Spearman-Brown magnifying an ordinary null draw (the raw half correlation is at the 18th percentile of the tau2=0 null). Route C is retired as evidence in either direction, which is the bounded outcome the spec allows. It was never an estimator.

field_provenance.note: E.15's Route B read this column via e_platoon_ceiling.load_c2_components['tau2_split']; for a DIFFERENTIAL the derived split variance IS the within-stand tau2, so the spec's parenthetical describes the same quantity.

reproduction.window_note: the spec's window PROSE is wrong; the committed VALUE reproduces exactly on the code's three-season window, so §10 rule 4 does not fire. B and B' differ only in population, which is what the B->B' diagnostic requires.

c3_full_availability.fallback_rule: §10 rule 1 — FIRED at Phase M (2026-08-30), DISCHARGED in Pass A1
c3_full_availability.why_it_fired: C.3-full had no persisted fitted artifact anywhere in `results/`, and `c3_gbm.predict` calls `c3_gbm.fit` internally, so side-specific predictions required retraining the GBM on the 341MB labeled pitch table — the condition rule 1 names.
c3_full_availability.why_it_is_discharged: the retrain is the supported path at `src/analysis/c_report.py:364` and costs 7 seconds, not the session it was scoped as. Pass A1 ran it once and persisted the output to `results/phase_m/m1_c3_full_predictions.csv`, so the rule's condition is false for every later pass.
c3_full_availability.reproduction: the refit reproduces the committed Phase C `c3_gbm_full` claim-1 row to 1.0e-9 on RMSE and 5.6e-17 on rank correlation in every stratum, so the 2026-08-31 revisit condition (absence becomes a capability limit if the refit cannot reproduce Phase C) does not fire.
c3_full_availability.never: no differential head was improvised, per the spec's explicit prohibition.
